name: 52402 · Cedar Rapids, IA
findings: ZIP 52402 (Cedar Rapids) has 208 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 52402 (Cedar Rapids) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 14 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
